incident_report.incident: Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with THOUSAND CUPS.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After passing the winning post was checked to avoid DECISION LINK (J Moreira) which shifted in.  J Moreira was reprimanded and advised he must ensure that he is sufficiently clear when he allows his mounts to shift ground.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing tight between THOUSAND CUPS which shifted out slightly and TEAM HAPPY which was taken in slightly by DECISION LINK.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by ALWAYS MY FOLKS which shifted in abruptly.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

J Orman stated that his mount was able to obtain a favourable position during the race and after initially responding to his riding in the early stages of the Home Straight commenced to give ground over the final 100 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Raced keenly in the early stages and making the first turn near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid CHILL MASTER.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied to avoid PODIUM (H Bowman) which shifted in when not quite clear.  H Bowman was advised to exercise more care.  M L Yeung stated that with his mount having its first race start for Trainer J Richards, he was asked to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
Bumped near the 300 Metres.

Shifted in abruptly on jumping and was bumped.  Near the 300  Metres was bumped by LEGENDARY IMPACT which shifted out slightly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted out slightly leaving the 50 Metres and brushed VIVACIOUS WIN.  Sent for sampling post-race.

K Teetan stated that with an expected lack of speed engaged in the race he was instructed to hold a more forward position than it did at its most recent race starts.  Leaving the 50 Metres was brushed by GENERAL REDWOOD which shifted out slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with PRECISION HOPE.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Leaving the 900 Metres raced keenly and was steadied to avoid CELTIC TIMES.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.  In the early stages of the Home Straight lay in and as a result was positioned close to GOLDEN DARCI near the 200 Metres when that runner commenced to give ground.

Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with GOLDEN DARCI.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Bumped shortly after the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After the 500 Metres improved to the inside of OSI HONOUR when that runner came under pressure.  When OSI HONOUR maintained its position making the Home Turn VERMILION TEMPEST was then held up when positioned behind SUPER GOLDENDRAGON.  Near the 150 Metres VERMILION TEMPEST, which was laying out, shifted out and was eased when positioned close to GOLDEN DARCI when that runner was giving ground.
Bumped shortly after the start.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Over the concluding stages shifted in, resulting in its rider Y L Chung having to stop riding and straighten his mount as it approached the winning post.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of TYCOON RESOURCES which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
No report.
No report.

Approaching the 500 Metres lay out and was steadied to avoid JOY STAR.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind BEAUTY THUNDER which shifted in.  J Moreira stated that his mount, which was fractious in the starting gates, jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  He added that ELEGANT LIFE travelled only fairly during the event and finished the race off in a one-paced manner in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Shortly after the start was bumped by FORZA LEADER which shifted out.  A short distance later GET FRIENDLY became unbalanced when crowded between FORZA LEADER and JOY STAR which was racing tight to the inside of HAPPY UNITED.  Shifted out approaching the 800 Metres and made contact with JOY STAR.

After travelling a short distance made contact with GET FRIENDLY when racing tight to the inside of HAPPY UNITED.  Approaching the 800 Metres, when racing ungenerously, got its head up and became unbalanced when racing in restricted room between GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP which shifted in slightly and GET FRIENDLY which shifted out and made contact with JOY STAR when being corrected by its rider.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. C Y Ho was reprimanded in relation to using his whip on a horse which was clearly out of contention.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Apprentice P N Wong stated that the intention was to go forward and attempt to lead.  She said despite riding her mount along in the early stages it did not show sufficient pace to do so.

On jumping bumped heavily with SMILING ONE due to both runners shifting ground.  When commencing a forward move to the outside of KING OF SELECTION near the 450 Metres was bumped and taken wider by KING OF SELECTION when that runner shifted out.  Near the 150 Metres shifted in under pressure and bumped ALL ROUND WINNER, resulting in its rider J Moreira having to stop riding and straighten his mount.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

In the early stages raced keenly when being steadied to allow AMAZING AWARD to cross.  Near the 150 Metres was bumped by GOLDEN BRILLIANT which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  H Bentley reported that on jumping his saddle slipped back, placing him at some disadvantage during the race.
No report.
No report.
On jumping shifted out and made contact with KING OF SELECTION.

Bumped at the start and shortly after was then crowded by AMAZING AWARD which shifted out.  Leaving the 1400 Metres shifted in and a short distance later became unbalanced when being corrected by its rider.  Leaving the 400 Metres shifted in and away from WINNING DATA when it improved into a narrow run.

On jumping made heavy contact with GOLDEN BRILLIANT due to both runners shifting ground.  SMILING ONE was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Making the turn near the 1200 Metres raced keenly and was steadied to avoid MADE FOR LIFE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped at the start.  Approaching the 1500 Metres made contact with KING OF SELECTION when racing tight to the inside of EXCELLENT BOY.  J Orman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with WHOWROTETHATSONG.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Leaving the 1400 Metres WINNING DATA, which was initially positioned to the outside of WHOWROTETHATSONG, was then shifted to the inside of WHOWROTETHATSONG (Y L Chung) as that runner commenced to shift in.  A short distance later WHOWROTETHATSONG was then corrected by its rider when it shifted in and crowded WINNING DATA in onto AUTOMATED which was also crowded for room.  As the Stewards were satisfied that WINNING DATA improved to the inside of WHOWROTETHATSONG as WHOWROTETHATSONG was commencing to shift in, Y L Chung was advised to exercise more care.  Leaving the 400 Metres WHOWROTETHATSONG improved into a narrow run to the inside of WINNING DATA.  A short distance later WINNING DATA was taken in slightly by INCANTO STAR, resulting in WHOWROTETHATSONG shifting in and away from WINNING DATA, crowding the running of AUTOMATED.  Y L Chung was advised in similar circumstances he must ensure that there is sufficient racing room when improving into runs.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After improving to the inside of WHOWROTETHATSONG was checked leaving the 1400 Metres when crowded by WHOWROTETHATSONG which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Near the 200 Metres was checked when crowded between KING OF SELECTION (C L Chau), which after making contact with INCANTO STAR, then shifted in and SMILING ONE (K C Leung) which shifted out.  C L Chau was reprimanded and K C Leung was advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to straighten his mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear.
Bumped at the start.  Approaching the 1500 Metres was bumped by INCANTO STAR.  Shifted out near the 450 Metres and made contact with GOLDEN BRILLIANT.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Leaving the 1100 Metres made contact with MONARCH COUNTY.
A Badel stated that his instructions were to go forward and attempt to obtain cover.  He said when FORERUNNER commenced well he was able to go forward but was unable to obtain cover.
Jumped only fairly.
Jumped only fairly.

Leaving the 1100 Metres made contact with FREE PONY, resulting in MONARCH COUNTY commencing to race ungenerously.  A short distance later MONARCH COUNTY shifted out and got its head up when being restrained to avoid FORERUNNER.  MONARCH COUNTY continued to race ungenerously in the middle stages and near the 750 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from FREE PONY.  J Moreira stated that the intention was to hold a slightly more forward position.  He said MONARCH COUNTY was not suited by the early stages of the event being run outside of standard time and finished the race off only fairly under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay in in the early stages of the Home Straight when being shifted out to obtain clear running.

Over the final 50 Metres raced in restricted room between FREE PONY and MONARCH COUNTY and as a result could not be fully ridden out to the end of the race.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Near the 200 Metres was eased to avoid MARVEL AND GOLD which shifted out to obtain clear running.  A Atzeni stated that his mount travelled only fairly during the event and after being hampered and taken wider on the Home Turn finished the race off in a one-paced manner in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Trainer C S Shum confirmed that from the outside barrier he had instructed H Bowman to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages. <9/4/2026 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that JOKER ORBIT was lame in its right front leg on the day after racing. Before being allowed to race again, JOKER ORBIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Slow to begin.
Sent for sampling post-race.
When placed under pressure in the Home Straight lay in, resulting in its rider H Bentley changing his whip through to his right hand near the 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in at the start and made contact with HAPPY BRETHREN.  Z Purton stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position.  He said after making contact with HAPPY BRETHREN on jumping and then racing tight between FLASH STAR and HAPPY BRETHREN shortly after the start he was obliged to settle further back in the field than what had been intended.  Sent for sampling post-race.
After being crossed by BIGTIME GENERATION near the 600 Metres was then steadied to avoid BIGTIME GENERATION when that runner was unable to continue forward.
Bumped on jumping and became unbalanced.
Jumped only fairly and then raced tight between CROSSBORDERDUDE and FLASH STAR.
No report.
No report.
No report.
Lay out under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid LUCKY MCQUEEN, shifted out and made contact with AWESOME TREASURE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover from the 700 Metres.  Bumped near the 550 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

SO MY FOLKS, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 5.4.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (bled after finishing track work).  Before being allowed to race again, SO MY FOLKS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

No report.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by ALLCASH.
No report.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Badel was fined the sum of $4,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 3 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.
Z Purton reported that he was satisfied with the performance of his mount.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with NOISY BOY.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn on 5.4.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (inappetence) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter NOISY BOY.  Before being allowed to race again, BLAZING WUKONG will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Blundered on jumping.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Shifted out at the start, made contact with KING MILES and became unbalanced.
J Orman stated that after jumping awkwardly his mount was unable to hold a more forward position.

Shifted in on jumping and became unbalanced when it made contact with CELESTIAL HERO.  Raced keenly in the early and middle stages when obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

On jumping was crowded between CHEAHA and ACE CHAMPION which shifted in.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of WONDER KIT to improve.  Approaching the 50 Metres made slight contact with WONDER KIT when improving to the outside of SPIRIT OF PEACE.
Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start was bumped heavily by WONDER KIT which shifted out.

Shifted out at the start and made heavy contact with CHEAHA.  Bumped near the 50 Metres.  <9/4/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> The Veterinary Surgeon reported that WONDER KIT was found to have a right front tendon injury on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, WONDER KIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.
Bumped at the start and became unbalanced.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted in at the start and made contact with MIGHTY COMMANDER when being corrected by its rider.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in at the start when being corrected by its rider.  Near the 550 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid FLYING WROTE.  Held up on the Home Turn.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.

Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed A Atzeni to go forward.
No report.

Badly crowded at the start.  Near the 550 Metres was checked to avoid MEOWTH when that runner lost ground.   Sent for sampling post-race. J Moreira was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 4 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.

Badly crowded at the start.  Near the 550 Metres was briefly crowded by MIGHTY COMMANDER which shifted in.  Held up on the Home Turn.  Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving behind RED SEA which was giving ground.  K Teetan stated that after being crowded at the start his mount settled further back in the field and as a result found it difficult to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

On jumping MEOWTH shifted in, resulting in SIGHT HERMOSO shifting in and away from MEOWTH despite the efforts of its rider.  As a result MIGHTY COMMANDER and KING OF FIGHTERS were badly crowded and VULCANUS checked when unable to maintain its position between FLYING HUNTER and KING OF FIGHTERS.

Shortly after the start was bumped by PRESTIGE ALWAYS which shifted out.  Z Purton could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer J Richards stated that Jockey Purton was required to make use of the horse in the early stages to lead which resulted in it racing inside of standard time.  He said notwithstanding this he was still disappointed with the horse’s finishing effort as the horse had pleased him in the lead up to tonight’s race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of RED REA was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, RED SEA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination. <9/4/2026 Additional Veterinary Report> RED SEA, which performed disappointingly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. RED SEA was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer J Richards this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg. As previously advised, RED SEA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters when being ridden to maintain its position.
